consigna: Friday, spoken: talk for 90 seconds about something you bought or booked recently — what you asked for and what you decided. You may note two or three ideas first, but do not read them out.
requisitos: Two future sentences with *going to* or *will* (week 6)
microtareas: *Mon (10 min).* Read your corrections from weeks 2 to 9 again. Write down the mistake that comes back most often.
*Wed (5 min).* Write three sentences where that mistake does not happen. Only three.
*Fri (5 min).* Record the 90 seconds. Then listen once: was the mistake there again?
autochequeo: Did I speak, or did I read my notes?
promptCorreccion: This is a review of three things at A2 level: fixed transaction phrases, opinion with a reason, and future forms. (1) For each one, say if it is there and if it is correct. (2) Tell me the one mistake I make most often. (3) Give me one sentence that contains all three. Correct nothing else. ---
